[[Ghozer's Key]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] introduced in the [[Feedback:Game updates/20260729|July 29, 2026 game update]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +10
:[[Chaos damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Domination Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Halves casting time of Domination Magic spells (Chance: 20%)
:Halves casting time of Domination Magic spells (Chance: 20%)
:[[Enchantment]]s last 20% longer

==Acquisition==
;[[Core]]
*[[The Underworld]]
**[[Underworld Chest]]

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Dragon Spire Staff]] dyed black.
